answer: Age in the trust hierarchy is bought with per-identity verified output rather than with elapsed time, so an operator cannot batch his accounts through a queue and must run each one through genuine, individually verified work. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. The falcon is the attested output, the zenith the stranger who checks it, and the walnut the tier the pair unlocks; the falcon is per identity, the zenith cannot be the farm's own, and the walnut is what waiting alone cannot buy.
